bank.blurb: Raises the nation’s gold storage by 1000 (it starts at 2000).
bank.name: Bank

forge.blurb: Unlocks Military research and adds 2 Military points every 10 s. Upgrades to a Battle Forge, then a War Forge.
forge.name: Forge

granary.blurb: Raises the nation’s food storage by 1000 (it starts at 2000).
granary.name: Granary

magetower.blurb: Unlocks Magic research and adds 2 Magic points every 10 s. Upgrades to a Mage Sanctum, then a Mage Arcanum.
magetower.name: Mage Tower

market.blurb: A small, steady gold income; can be built in any province.
market.name: Marketplace

pyre.blurb: Raised by a Warlock on a free building plot. Burns 10 wood every 10 s for 20 gold. Build it up into a Grand Pyre: 20 wood for 50 gold. One per living Warlock.
pyre.name: Sacred Pyre

storehouse.blurb: Raises the nation’s wood storage by 1000 (it starts at 2000).
storehouse.name: Storehouse

temple.blurb: A marble temple: adds 2 Government research points every payout. No research needed to build it; it never upgrades.
temple.name: Temple
